summary: Temporary danger area for drone operations up to 1,100 ft near Beckwithshaw, Harrogate, daily from 0800 to 2300.
text:
TEMPO DANGER AREA (TDA) EGD390C INSTALLED WI 1.6NM RADIUS OF
535842N 0013408W (BECKWITHSHAW, HARROGATE). BEYOND VISUAL LINE OF
SIGHT (BVLOS) UAS OPS CONTAINED WHOLLY WI THE TDA. MAX HGT 400FT
AGL. EMERG SERVICES ACFT MAY ENTER THE AIRSPACE IN ACCORDANCE
WITH LOCAL DECONFLICTION AGREEMENTS. OPEN AND SPECIFIC CAT VISUAL
LINE OF SIGHT (VLOS) UAS OPS ARE PERMITTED WI THE TDA WITHOUT
PRIOR APPROVAL OR DECONFLICTION. OTHER NON-STANDARD FLIGHT,
FLIGHT RESTRICTION ZONE OR CONTROLLED AIRSPACE APPROVALS MUST BE
OBTAINED. OPERATORS ARE REMINDED OF THEIR RESPONSIBILITY UNDER
CAP722 5.2.2.3 REGARDING OPR IN CLOSE PROXIMITY TO AN EMERG
RESPONSE EFFORT. FOR INFO AROPS(AT)CAA.CO.UK. AR-2026-5766/03.
